chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: During the course of the second world war, which began on September i, 1939, growing numbers of persons came to the conclusion that this war could not be adequately understood in the usual military and diplomatic terms.
text_raw:
During  the  course  of  the  second  world  war,  which
began  on  September  i,  1939,  growing  numbers  of  persons
came  to  the  conclusion  that  this  war  could  not  be  adequately
understood  in  the  usual  military  and  diplomatic  terms.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: Of course, each participant in every big war is careful to explain that it fights, not for any vulgar purpose of mere conquest, but for liberty, justice, God, and the future of mankind.
text_raw:
Of
course,  each  participant  in  every  big  war  is  careful  to  explain
that  it  fights,  not  for  any  vulgar  purpose  of  mere  conquest,
but  for  liberty,  justice,  God,  and  the  future  of  mankind.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: The second world war is no exception to this general rule which seems to express a deep need of men’s moral nature when confronted with the task of mutual slaughter.
text_raw:
The  second  world  war  is  no  exception  to  this  general  rule
which  seems  to  express  a deep  need  of  men’s  moral  nature
when  confronted  with  the  task  of  mutual  slaughter.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: Never- theless, with all allowances for the general rule, there still remains, on the part of trained and intelligent as well as casual observers, the conviction that this war is not an ordinary war.
text_raw:
Never-
theless, with  all  allowances  for  the  general  rule,  there  still
remains,  on  the  part  of  trained  and  intelligent  as  well  as
casual  observers,  the  conviction  that  this  war  is  not  an
ordinary  war.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: The difference has been stated by some in calling the war a “ revolution ” ; more particularly, a “ social revolution.” For example, the well-known American ■writer, Qpincy Howe, in his radio commentaries insisted time after time on such an interpretation.

a “ revolution  ” ; more  particularly,  a “ social  revolution.”
For  example,  the  well-known  American  ■writer,  Qpincy  Howe,
in  his  radio  commentaries  insisted  time  after  time  on  such  an

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: Germany, he kept repeating, is not merely sending a remarkably organized military machine across its borders.

sending  a remarkably  organized  military  machine  across  its

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: Her military machine is the carrier of a social revolution which is transforming the social system on the European continent.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: However, when we examine what such observers have said and written, we discover that, though they have been firm in their insistence that the second world war is a social revo- lution, they have been by no means clear in describing what kind of revolution it is, what it consists of, where it is leading, what type of society will emerge from it.
text_raw:
However,  when  we  examine  what  such  observers  have  said
and  written,  we  discover  that,  though  they  have  been  firm
in  their  insistence  that  the  second  world  war  is  a social  revo-
lution, they  have  been  by  no  means  clear  in  describing  what
kind  of  revolution  it  is,  what  it  consists  of,  where  it  is  leading,
what  type  of  society  will  emerge  from  it.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: We must be careful not to permit historical judgment to be distorted by the staggering emotional impact of the war itself.

We  must  be  careful  not  to  permit  historical  judgment  to
be  distorted  by  the  staggering  emotional  impact  of  the  war
itself.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: If a major social revolution is now in fact occurring, the war is subordinate to the revolution, not the other way around.
text_raw:
If  a major  social  revolution  is  now  in  fact  occurring,
the  war  is  subordinate  to  the  revolution,  not  the  other  way
around.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: The war in the final analysis — and future wars — is an episode in the revolution.
text_raw:
The  war  in  the  final  analysis — and  future  wars —
is  an  episode  in  the  revolution.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: We cannot understand the revolution by restricting our analysis to the war ; we must understand the war as a phase in the development of the revolution.

We  cannot  understand  the
revolution  by  restricting  our  analysis  to  the  war  ; we  must
understand  the  war  as  a phase  in  the  development  of  the
revolution.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: Moreover, the role of Germany in the revolution, if it is a revolution, should not be exaggerated.

revolution,  should  not  be  exaggerated.

text: If they came to so startling a head in Germany, this does not mean that they have not been driving steadily beneath the surface — and not so far beneath — in other nations, in all other nations for that matter.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: The system of property relations, the forms under which economic production is carried on, the legal structure, the type of political organization and regime, arc all so sharply altered that we feel compelled to call them different in kind, not merely modified in degree.
text_raw:
The
system  of  property  relations,  the  forms  under  which  economic
production  is  carried  on,  the  legal  structure,  the  type  of
political  organization  and  regime,  arc  all  so  sharply  altered
that  we  feel  compelled  to  call  them  different  in  kind,  not
merely  modified  in  degree.

text: Along with the changes in social institutions there go more or less parallel changes in cultural institutions and in the dominant beliefs which men hold about man’s place in the world and the universe.

the  world  and  the  universe.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: This cultural shift is plainly seen in the transition from feudal to modern capitalist society, both in the reorganization of the form and place of such institutions as the Church and the schools, and in the com- plete alteration of the general view of the world, of life, and of man which took place during the Renaissance.

institutions  as  the  Church  and  the  schools,  and  in  the  com-
plete alteration  of  the  general  view  of  the  world,  of  life,  and
of  man  which  took  place  during  the  Renaissance.

chapter_title: Frontmatter
text: To say that a social revolution is occurring at the present time is, then, equivalent to saying that the present is a period characterized by a very rapid rate of social change, that it is a period of transition from one type of society — that type which has prevailed from, roughly, the fifteenth century to the early part of the twentieth — to a new and different type of society.
text_raw:
To  say  that  a social  revolution  is  occurring  at  the  present
time  is,  then,  equivalent  to  saying  that  the  present  is  a period
characterized  by  a very  rapid  rate  of  social  change,  that  it
is  a period  of  transition  from  one  type  of  society — that  type
which  has  prevailed  from,  roughly,  the  fifteenth  century  to
the  early  part  of  the  twentieth — to  a new  and  different  type
of  society.

text: For centuries, men’s activities are worked out within a given, more or less stable, framework of social and cultural institutions ; changes take place, but not to such an extent as to alter the basic framework.

socialists,  communists,  and  their  subvarieties  are  the  same.
